description.value: Discovery Coffee is a locally rooted Victoria specialty coffee roaster operating multiple cafe locations across the city, including this Oak Bay Avenue outpost. The company runs its own roastery on Rock Bay Avenue and partners with Yonni's Doughnuts, making it a notable stop for coffee and baked goods. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient neighbourhood cafe in the heart of Oak Bay.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Discovery Coffee is a real, active multi-location coffee roaster and cafe in Victoria, BC (copyright 2026, locations page lists Oak Bay among active sites). The OSM address (1964 Oak Bay Avenue) conflicts with the website's Oak Bay listing (1920 Oak Bay Avenue), so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned on the website; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by website content per the rules, so it is left null.
